relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Capsaicin (a TRPV1 agonist) may provide analgesia with limited systemic side effects.

key_findings: Review: guidelines endorse high-concentration capsaicin patches for painful chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy
RCT data in cancer pain are lacking, but cohort studies support capsaicin patches in treatment-related neuropathic pain
